scope: Independent source review of the final Done-phase diagnostic/helper cleanup delta; no browser, product source, workflows, or repo writes.
cleanupControlFlow: Normal helper path: after a successful trusted mouse click, the helper detaches; if detach succeeds, it returns normally. If detach alone fails, it records phase=detach and throws that failure.

Failure path: the catch records and retains the first operation error; detach is attempted afterward. A detach failure is suppressed when an earlier error exists, then the original error is thrown after cleanup. This avoids a throw from finally overwriting the first failure.

The new combined fault injection forces DOM.enable ProtocolError plus detach error through the actual helper and reviewer runner. It asserts the original DOM-enable message and phase survive; serialized reviewer proof contains neither injected private marker. Existing detach-only and normal-detach tests remain passing.
diagnosticAndGateReview: Phase enumeration tracks the actual helper calls. Only phase/category enums, nullable booleans, and finite bounded geometry are projected. Data picker count=1 remains required before Done; post-Done selected-field, cancel-ready, and guest-explanation gates and existing cleanup attempts remain intact.
limitations: Exact Store candidate/native behavior remains pending; this is source/test review only, not product or candidate acceptance.
